services.desc: Aloha Big Island Banana Boat Rides are a sure way put a smile on your face and joy in your heart! If you are looking for non stop laughter from start to finish, then this is the ride for you!! Rates $25 per person Early Bird Special! Before 11am, enjoy discounted prices - $5 off!" From the thrill of powering through the surf, to the view while gliding over the ocean with the dolphins, the Big Island Banana is guaranteed to keep you coming back for more! services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Aloha Parasail Rides are a perfect blend of adventure, thrill and relaxation. Our experienced crew is dedicated to giving you and yours a fun safe flight above the clouds! Rates Flyers - $82 Observers - Book parasailing first to unlock observers - $39.00 Early Bird Special - $67! Before 11am, enjoy discounted prices and a higher chance of seeing dolphins! Duration 10 - 15 minutes in the air 30 - 45 minutes total for the experience About Aloha offers 2-person and 3-person parasail rides so you can share your adventure with the ones you love! We also offer Professional Photo Packages for every flight and will be available when you get back to the Beach!! Requirements Minimum weight: 35lbs
